b2-mexicocentro-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Sinking Valley
b2-mexicocentro-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Mexico City in Budapest. It says the ground of the city is sinking.
b2-mexicocentro-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what worries people most today, with a cleft sentence.
cues: Say that what worries people most is one thing
Name the sinking of the ground
b2-mexicocentro-01.target: Lo que más preocupa hoy es el hundimiento del suelo.
b2-mexicocentro-01.english: What worries people most today is the sinking of the ground.
b2-mexicocentro-01.canDo: I can use a cleft sentence with lo que to put a key cause or fact about the Valley of Mexico in the spotlight.

b2-mexicocentro-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Dike of Nezahualcóyotl
b2-mexicocentro-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You are telling Meg about an article on Tenochtitlan that you read in Budapest. It praised the dike of Nezahualcóyotl.
b2-mexicocentro-02.prompt: Tell Meg that the dike was very important, with the important thing first.
cues: Say what the dike did for the city
b2-mexicocentro-02.target: Muy importante fue el albarradón para proteger la ciudad.
b2-mexicocentro-02.english: The dike was very important for protecting the city.
b2-mexicocentro-02.canDo: I can put a quality or a place first, as in Importante fue ..., to stress it when I tell about Tenochtitlan.

b2-mexicocentro-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Life in the Colonial Street
b2-mexicocentro-03.scenario: You are Meg. You are preparing a talk in Budapest about colonial Mexico City, and Carlos asks about the caste system.
b2-mexicocentro-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that life in the street was more mixed than the castes, using a stance adverb.
cues: Open with an adverb that corrects an idea
Say that the street was more mixed than the castes
b2-mexicocentro-03.target: En realidad, la vida de la calle era más mezclada que las castas.
b2-mexicocentro-03.english: Actually, life in the street was more mixed than the castes.
b2-mexicocentro-03.canDo: I can use a stance adverb such as en realidad or indudablemente to show how I see a fact about the colonial city.

b2-mexicocentro-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Murals for the People
b2-mexicocentro-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You are talking to Meg in Budapest about a documentary on Mexican muralism.
b2-mexicocentro-04.prompt: Tell Meg what the murals were not and what they were.
cues: Say what the murals were not
b2-mexicocentro-04.target: Los murales no eran para decorar, sino para enseñar la historia.
b2-mexicocentro-04.english: The murals were not for decoration but for teaching history.
b2-mexicocentro-04.canDo: I can correct an idea with no ... sino and no ... sino que when I talk about the murals.

b2-mexicocentro-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Earthquake
b2-mexicocentro-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are reading an article about the 1985 earthquake in Mexico City, and Carlos asks who organised the help.
b2-mexicocentro-05.prompt: Tell Carlos who formed the rescue teams, with a cleft sentence.
b2-mexicocentro-05.target: Fueron los vecinos quienes formaron brigadas.
b2-mexicocentro-05.english: It was the neighbours who formed rescue teams.
b2-mexicocentro-05.canDo: I can tell what happened in Mexico City in 1985, using clefts, fronting and no ... sino together.

b2-mexicocentro-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Fall of Tenochtitlan
b2-mexicocentro-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You are giving a short talk in Budapest about central Mexico, and you reach the year 1521.
b2-mexicocentro-consolidation.prompt: Say when Tenochtitlan fell and what was built afterwards.
cues: Say the year with a cleft sentence
Say what was built on the remains
b2-mexicocentro-consolidation.target: Fue en 1521 cuando cayó Tenochtitlan. Sobre sus restos se construyó la ciudad colonial.
b2-mexicocentro-consolidation.english: It was in 1521 that Tenochtitlan fell. On its remains the colonial city was built.
b2-mexicocentro-consolidation.canDo: I can recall the main facts about central Mexico: the lake basin, Tenochtitlan, the colonial city, muralism and the 1985 earthquake.
